The bulk of this batch is the flat/manifest-led family, not the tiered family.

CROSS-READING COHERENCE: the two spaces agree closely. Every path-null row reads flat-namespace; every path-heavy row reads taxonomic-zones except ce2a08 (which X cannot express as no-layout); both path-light rows read axis-rooted. The only structural disagreement the two spaces produce is at ce2a08, and it is an artefact of X lacking a no-layout value.

It is the single `recomputed` row and the only row whose custody value is forced rather than evidenced.

FREE-FORM (ce2a08): no-layout is the honest Y value — the row explicitly demotes the tree to \"only a projection of this graph\". It still names regeneration checks and provenance validation, so it is not weak on assurance; it simply declines to carry organisation in paths. Its X placement is the one genuinely forced value in this batch.

CONTESTED ROWS (5): 1f76be (custody unevidenced; axis-rooted vs incumbent-tuned; single-consumer flag brushes telemetry), 64ee76 (a heterogeneous taxonomy compressed into one \"domain-first\" segment — path-heavy by content, path-light by segment count), 836273 (change-coupling reports named as a standing carrier but explicitly non-automatic, no threshold/cadence), ce2a08 (X has no no-layout value), sol-seeded (durability-split vs committed-verified, with the commit-vs-artefact-store question named as unanswered in its own notes).

BOUNDARY CALL APPLIED CONSISTENTLY: static graph structure (fan-in, fan-out, cycles, SCCs, single-consumer, \"accidental shared platform\" candidates) was read as recomputed/rule-static, not as telemetry. Only signals measured over history or the build graph with a named cadence or metric — bea367's \"scheduled graph analysis flags high co-change pairs\" and 836273's change-coupling / repeated-multi-unit-change reports — were promoted to self-correcting / telemetry-governed.
